Keyboard Shortcuts

  
Ctrl = Ctrl on Windows / Cmd on Mac

  


    
Global

    
Save projectCtrl+S

    
Open projectCtrl+O

    
Undo / RedoCtrl+Z / Ctrl+Y

    
Find / replaceCtrl+F

    
Export PDFCtrl+P

    
Zoom in / out / resetCtrl+= / Ctrl+− / Ctrl+0

    
Focus modeF11

    
Keyboard shortcutsF1

    
Revision modeCtrl+Shift+E

    
Dual dialogueCtrl+Shift+D


    
Screenplay

    
Cycle elementsTab / Shift+Tab

    
Set element typeCtrl+1…9

    
Quick INT./EXT. headingINT or EXT, then Tab

    
Auto-wrap parentheticalTab under CHARACTER

    
Previous / next sceneCtrl+↑ / Ctrl+↓

    
Scene optionsRight-click scene


    
Autocomplete

    
Navigate suggestions↑ / ↓

    
Accept suggestionTab / Enter

    
DismissEsc


    
Storyboard / Paint

    
Delete selected shotsDelete

    
Duplicate selected shotsCtrl+D

    
Brush / Eraser / FillB / E / F

    
GradientG

    
Eyedropper / ShapeI / U

    
Swap / reset colorsX / D

    
Transform layerT

    
PanSpace

    
Brush size[ / ]

    
Softness{ / }

    
Layer opacityShift+0…9

    
Undo / RedoCtrl+Z / Ctrl+Y

    
Confirm / cancelEnter / Esc


    
Concept Canvas

    
Add to selectionShift/Ctrl+click

    
Move selected node(s)← ↑ → ↓ (Shift = larger)

    
Duplicate nodeCtrl+D

    
Delete nodeDelete

    
Layer order (step)[ / ]

    
Layer order (to end)Shift+[ / Shift+]


    
Animatic

    
Play / pauseSpace

    
Step frame← / →

    
Jump to start / endHome / End

    
Select / Track selectV / A

    
Razor / Ripple editC / B

    
Slide / SlipN / Y

    
Split at playheadS

    
Trim to playheadT

    
Delete clip / close gapDelete

    
Duplicate clipCtrl+D

    
Toggle snapM

    
Fit all / fit selectionF / Shift+F

    
Set loop in / outI / O

    
Toggle loopL

    
Clear selectionEsc
